title: kv-cache: adaptive spillover paging and defragmentation heuristics + memory manager
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: reduce GPU-side KV cache fragmentation and OOMs during long-lived streaming workloads by improving spillover paging and adding adaptive defragmentation heuristics. This PR introduces a lightweight memory manager for KV spillover into host memory, a background defrag/coalescing worker, and adaptive eviction policies that consider fragmentation score and access hotness. Changes are guarded behind a runtime feature flag (kv_adaptive_spillover=true) and include benchmarks and unit+integration tests. Summary of changes and rationale: the existing spillover path used a naive per-entry allocator which produced fragmentation under churn (many short-lived prefixes). We now: 1) introduce a slab-backed host allocator for spillover pages to reduce fragmentation, 2) implement a background coalescer that opportunistically merges adjacent free spans, 3) add a fragmentation-aware eviction priority that favors compacting cold large entries before evicting hot small ones, and 4) expose configuration knobs for page_size, max_host_spill_bytes, defrag_interval_ms, and fragmentation_threshold. Checklist: - [x] Implementation of host slab allocator and page lifecycle - [x] Defragmentation/coalescer worker with bounded CPU usage - [x] Fragmentation-aware eviction policy and LRU+hotness scoring - [x] Feature flag + config via runtime flags and env vars - [x] Unit tests for allocator, coalescer, eviction ordering - [x] Integration test using perf-canary workload to validate no OOM regressions - [x] Benchmarks comparing tail latency and OOMs before/after Backward compatibility and rollout: default is off. Operator can enable per-cluster. We added metrics to allow safe rollout: kv.spill.host_bytes, kv.spill.fragments, kv.defrag.runs, kv.eviction.fragmentation_score. Docs and release notes included. Related: ENG-2123 (adaptive-eviction initiative), ENG-1987 (kv cache spillover design doc).

review_comments: Evan Zhang: Nice work — can you add a safety timeout to the defrag worker so it never holds a page lock more than 10ms?
Author (Priya Raman): Good catch, added max_lock_hold_ms and defensive checks in latest commit (c3f7a9b).
Isabel Gomez: The eviction comparator looks correct but we should ensure it doesn't penalize extremely long sequences; added test for long-kv-keys in tests/kv/eviction_integration_test.cc.
Marcus Lee: CI flaked on the perf-canary run once; looks like a quota issue. Re-ran and green. Approved pending changelog entry.
Reviewer (Miguel Soto): Please include telemetry for defrag CPU time per run so we can observe cost impact.
release_notes: Improves KV cache stability by introducing adaptive spillover paging and fragmentation-aware evictions. Operators can enable via kv_adaptive_spillover runtime flag. Adds new metrics: kv.spill.host_bytes, kv.spill.fragments, kv.defrag.runs, kv.defrag.cpu_ms, kv.eviction.fragmentation_score.
